## Angular Scheduler Component

The [Kendo UI for Angular Scheduler](https://www.telerik.com/kendo-angular-ui/scheduler) component offers an in-app calendar experience similar to Outlook or Google Calendar. The Angular Scheduler comes with several essential user features: different views, including day and month views, support for multiple resources, editing of events through a form or by dragging and resizing, time zone conversions and more. Every feature can be enabled through a single configuration option or deeply customized with a flexible API.

<img src="https://d585tldpucybw.cloudfront.net/sfimages/default-source/component-pages/angular/angular-scheduler-overview.jpg" alt="Angular Scheduler Calendar Example">

## Key Features

Among the many features which the Kendo UI for Angular Scheduler delivers are:

* [Multiple views](https://www.telerik.com/kendo-angular-ui/components/scheduler/views/)&mdash;Display Scheduler events in any of the available **Timeline**, **Day**, **Week**, **Month**, or **Agenda** views.
* [Editing](https://www.telerik.com/kendo-angular-ui/components/scheduler/editing/)&mdash;Depending on your users' requirements, you can provide editing from an external form or Reactive Forms, and also further customize the Scheduler.
* [Timezones](https://www.telerik.com/kendo-angular-ui/components/scheduler/timezones/)&mdash;You can display the events in the Scheduler in different timezones when building multinational applications.
* [Data Binding](https://www.telerik.com/kendo-angular-ui/components/scheduler/data-binding/)&mdash;The Scheduler provides a set of data binding approaches including the use of built-in directives, model and resource binding, as well as manual binding to the `events` attribute of the component.
* [Recurring Events](https://www.telerik.com/kendo-angular-ui/components/scheduler/recurring-events)&mdash;The built-in recurrence engine supports evaluation of recurring events in accordance to the Calendar format.
* [Toolbar](https://www.telerik.com/kendo-angular-ui/components/scheduler/toolbar/)&mdash;Provides a template that allows the customization of the toolbar and the addition of new components.
* [Export to PDF](https://www.telerik.com/kendo-angular-ui/components/scheduler/pdf-export/)&mdash;The Scheduler can be exported to PDF documents without the need for server-side helpers.
* [Templates](https://www.telerik.com/kendo-angular-ui/components/scheduler/templates)&mdash;Provides sets of configuration options for customizing the display of its elements such as event, slot, header, and agenda templates.
* [Slot Selection](https://www.telerik.com/kendo-angular-ui/components/scheduler/slot-selection)&mdash;Enables the user to choose time and day slots, and to select time ranges by clicking and dragging over a set of slots.
* [Styling](https://www.telerik.com/kendo-angular-ui/components/scheduler/styling)&mdash;You can customize the appearance of the Scheduler events, slots and views using the provided functional callbacks.
* [Globalization](https://www.telerik.com/kendo-angular-ui/components/scheduler/globalization/)&mdash;By using the available globalization options in Kendo UI for Angular, you can translate the Scheduler messages by adapting them to specific culture locales. Additionally, the Scheduler supports rendering in a right-to-left (RTL) direction.
* [Accessibility](https://www.telerik.com/kendo-angular-ui/components/scheduler/accessibility/)&mdash;The Kendo UI for Angular Scheduler is compliant with the Section 508 requirements. The Scheduler is accessible by screen readers and provides WAI-ARIA support.
* [Keyboard Navigation](https://www.telerik.com/kendo-angular-ui/components/scheduler/keyboard-navigation)&mdash;The Kendo UI for Angular Scheduler supports a number of keyboard shortcuts which allow users to accomplish various commands.
